description: This file implements the I2S bus (SAI) driver for NXP i.MX RT series, including DMA handling, stream management, configuration, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: i2s_dma_tx_callback
methods.description: DMA callback for transmit stream, handles buffer freeing and reloading DMA blocks.

methods.name: i2s_tx_stream_disable
methods.description: Disables the transmit DMA stream and resets FIFO, optionally purging buffers.

methods.name: i2s_rx_stream_disable
methods.description: Disables the receive DMA stream and resets FIFO, optionally purging buffers.

methods.name: i2s_tx_reload_multiple_dma_blocks
methods.description: Reloads multiple DMA blocks for TX stream from input queue.

methods.name: i2s_dma_rx_callback
methods.description: DMA callback for receive stream, handles buffer management and reloading DMA.

methods.name: enable_mclk_direction
methods.description: Sets the direction of the master clock pin.

methods.name: get_mclk_rate
methods.description: Retrieves the current MCLK rate from clock control.

methods.name: i2s_mcux_config
methods.description: Configures the I2S interface with specified parameters, including format, clock, and sync modes.

methods.name: i2s_mcux_config_get
methods.description: Returns the current configuration for TX or RX.

methods.name: i2s_tx_stream_start
methods.description: Starts the TX stream by configuring DMA and enabling the interface.

methods.name: i2s_rx_stream_start
methods.description: Starts the RX stream by configuring DMA and enabling the interface.

methods.name: i2s_mcux_trigger
methods.description: Handles trigger commands (start, stop, drain, prepare, drop) for TX or RX streams.

methods.name: i2s_mcux_read
methods.description: Reads data from the RX stream buffer.

methods.name: i2s_mcux_write
methods.description: Writes data to the TX stream buffer.

methods.name: i2s_mcux_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine handling FIFO errors.

methods.name: i2s_mcux_initialize
methods.description: Initializes the I2S device, sets up DMA, IRQ, clock, and pinctrl.
